meta.description: Command with Clarity — smart workforce management for security teams

footer.tagline: Command with Clarity — workforce management for UK security companies.

home.heroSubtitle: Guards, sites, rotas, payroll and invoicing. Subscribe to a plan, create your company, and operate with full control and compliance.

scalable.label: From small teams to large ops

home.featuresSubtitle: One platform for staffing, scheduling, pay and billing. Built for security companies.
home.howSubtitle: Get from signup to live operations in three steps.

plan.title: Choose your plan
plan.desc: Pick Basic, Standard or Premium. No long-term lock-in.

signup.title: Create your company
signup.desc: Sign up with your details and company name in under a minute.

live.title: Go live
live.desc: Add guards, sites and start scheduling. Payroll and invoices ready when you are.

guards.title: Guard management
guards.desc: Track guards, SIA licences, documents and compliance with expiry alerts.

sites.title: Sites & clients
sites.desc: Manage sites, clients and contact details with default rates per site.

rota.title: Assignments & rota
rota.desc: Schedule shifts, day/night/holiday rates and view rota by date range.

payroll.title: Payroll
payroll.desc: Calculate pay from assignments, bank/cash split, allowances and payslips.

invoices.title: Invoicing
invoices.desc: Generate client invoices from assignments with PDF export.

compliance.title: Compliance
compliance.desc: Expiring document alerts so you stay on top of SIA and right-to-work.

subs.title: Sub-contractors
subs.desc: Manage sub-contractor details and licence numbers.

rates.title: Allowances & rates
rates.desc: Guard and site rates, allowances in payroll and invoices.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Active guards, revenue, late arrivals, upcoming shifts at a glance.

home.quote: We moved from spreadsheets to this platform and cut admin time by half. Rota, payroll and invoices in one place—exactly what a security company needs.
home.complianceDesc: SIA licence tracking, document expiry alerts and right-to-work status in one place. Stay audit-ready without the spreadsheet chaos.
home.fastDesc: Sign up, create your company and add your first guards and sites in minutes. No lengthy onboarding or IT setup.
home.pricingTitle: Choose a plan and create your company
home.pricingDesc: Three tiers to match your size. Sign up once and start managing guards, sites and payroll.

plan.q: Can I change my plan later?
plan.a: Yes. You can upgrade or downgrade your subscription from your account.

secure.a: We treat security as a priority. Access is authenticated and data is stored securely.

sia.a: Yes. Track SIA numbers, expiry dates and get alerts before documents expire.

trial.q: Can I try before I subscribe?
trial.a: Create a company on any plan and start using the platform. Contact us for tailored trials.
